      <p class="intro-text">College is the most important investment you’ll ever make. At Fairleigh Dickinson, we work closely with you and your family to make our quality private education an affordable investment. Apply for admission to be automatically considered for our best range of scholarship opportunities. No separate scholarship application is needed.</p>
<h2>An overview of our scholarships <br />
and financial aid</h2>
<p>FDU offers a wide range of scholarships and grants.  </p>
<h2>To be considered for an FDU academic scholarship or grant</h2>
<p>We urge incoming students and their families to file the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) no later than <strong>March 15 </strong>for maximum consideration for need-based grants. FDU’s Federal school code is 002607.</p>
<p>File your <a href="https://studentaid.gov/h/apply-for-aid/fafsa">FAFSA online.</a></p>
<p>You can now apply for many FDU scholarships on <a href="https://fdu.awardspring.com/">AwardSpring.</a> Your GPA and major are automatically matched to many scholarships but go to the Dashboard tab to explore other scholarship opportunities that you may be qualified for that require additional information from you. <a href="https://www.fdu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Step-by-step-student-instructions.pdf">Check out this training document for more details.</a> You will need to have filed a FAFSA to be eligible for many of the scholarships on AwardSpring.</p>
<h2>We are here to help you!</h2>
<p>For any questions you might have about our scholarship and financial aid programs at FDU, please contact us.  Financial Aid staff are present at our Open Houses and larger events.  Check <a href="https://www.fdu.edu/admissions/visit-fdu/">Upcoming Admissions Events</a> for details on upcoming programs.</p>
